title: Run independent whole-program data acceptance
objective: Astra has reproducible evidence that the data/API program meets its stated targets.
outcome: Catalog and field denominators are recomputed from accepted frozen identities. Every baseline ID and selected cohort member reconciles. No success total counts missing or unattempted work. Decisive qualify-core, deterministic, MRF, join, coverage, and machine-transport checks are independently replayed. R01-R11 and R14-R15 are marked pass/fail/unverified with evidence. Merged planned PRs do not declare the program complete. Full-catalog review and sampled upstream validation are distinguished. C-009-1 remains unresolved. R01-R16 remain unaccepted. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. A passing schema is not scientific approval.

commits.subject: Recompute all catalog and field denominators
commits.instructions: Use accepted canonical records, attempt logs, dictionary/schema bindings, source intake and MRF cohorts. Validate references, uniqueness, exclusions and clock-based freshness.
commits.verification: Every baseline ID and every selected cohort member reconciles; no success total counts missing or unattempted work.

commits.subject: Replay decisive research/data checks
commits.instructions: Independently rerun sample/schema-key reconciliation, scientific negative cases, fifteen joins, source coverage, model quality and all machine transports.
commits.verification: Astra's receipt identifies exact commands/artifacts; producer logs are supporting material rather than the independent result.

commits.subject: Issue a requirement-by-requirement result
commits.instructions: For R01-R11/R14-R15, mark pass/fail/unverified with evidence and remaining scope. Open bounded remediation PRs for any deficit and rerun affected acceptance.
commits.verification: Do not declare the program complete because all originally planned PRs merged; actual requirement failures block release qualification.
